page_title: CAG 2-1 TOR | Cagliari v Torino 17/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+2' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Torino, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
87' Saul Coco (Torino) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
85' Here comes a substitution. Emirhan Ilkhan is given a rest as he is replaced by Sandro Kulenovic (Torino).
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Sebastiano Esposito leaves the pitch and Juan Rodriguez (Cagliari) comes on.
82' Here is a change. Paul Mendy is going off and Fabio Pisacane gives the last tactical orders to Andrea Belotti (Cagliari).
82' Guillermo Maripan (Torino) is awarded a yellow card for a sharp discussion with the referee. He should relax or he could be sent off.
82' Paul Mendy (Cagliari) goes into the book for bad language. His vulgar comments could have made it worse. Luckily for him, it's a yellow card.
80' Emirhan Ilkhan (Torino) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
79' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Cagliari.
77' Marcus Pedersen will be replaced by Alieu Njie (Torino).
75' Giovanni Simeone (Torino) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
75' A pass into the box finds Che Adams (Torino) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the bottom right corner, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Elia Caprile denies him.
72' Fabio Pisacane prepares a substitution. Alessandro Deiola is replaced by Michael Folorunsho (Cagliari).
72' It's time for a substitution. Ibrahim Sulemana (Cagliari) comes on in place of Michel Adopo.
70' The foul by Cesare Casadei (Torino) was seen by Alberto Arena who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
68' The Torino players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
65' The resulting set piece from Cagliari is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
63' Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
62' Che Adams (Torino) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Elia Caprile was alert and made a comfortable save.
59' Roberto D'Aversa decides to make a substitution. Duvan Zapata will be replaced by Che Adams (Torino).
59' Substitution. Matteo Prati leaves the pitch and is replaced by Cesare Casadei (Torino).

57' Marco Palestra (Cagliari) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and shoots. His poorly placed shot flies well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.
55' Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Alberto Paleari, who smothers the ball.
52' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Torino, is overhit and the ball goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.

51' Michel Adopo (Cagliari) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Alberto Arena no option but to blow his whistle. Torino have been awarded a free kick.
48' Neat passing move from Torino in order to create new attacking opportunities.

46' Alberto Dossena (Cagliari) finds some space to control the ball from the corner and shoots, but his attempt goes way wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.
46' The linesman makes the right call and Cagliari will have a corner.
46' Roberto D'Aversa has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Guillermo Maripan (Torino) comes on the pitch for Luca Marianucci.
46' Referee Alberto Arena blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' 2 - 1 Yerry Mina (Cagliari) gets to the rebound in the goalmouth and plants a header home.

45+2' Gabriele Zappa (Cagliari) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the top left corner. Alberto Paleari is alert, though, and leaps like a salmon to deny him.
45+2' Cagliari have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
43' Marcus Pedersen (Torino) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
42' The Cagliari players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
39' 1 - 1 Goal - 1:1! Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) gets a shot away from the edge of the box and scores into the bottom right corner. Gianluca Gaetano provided an assist for the goal.
37' 0 - 1 Goal! Rafael Obrador (Torino) is teed up on the edge of the box by Matteo Prati, and his howitzer of a shot into the top left corner gives the keeper no chance. 0:1.
37' Torino take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
35' Giovanni Simeone (Torino) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.

32' Giovanni Simeone (Torino) gets on the end of a lofted pass near the penalty spot, but it's a poor header and drifts high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.

30' Giovanni Simeone (Torino) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
27' Cagliari control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
23' Referee Alberto Arena sees the trip by Sebastiano Esposito (Cagliari) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
20' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
19' Marco Palestra (Cagliari) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the bottom left corner, but Alberto Paleari pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
19' Luca Marianucci (Torino) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.

17' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Cagliari are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
14' The Torino players are exchanging some short passes.
11' Cagliari work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
9' Cagliari failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
7' Great teamplay by Torino as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
4' Alberto Arena interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Luca Marianucci (Torino).
1' The first half has started.
Torino will kick-off.
Alberto Arena got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
